description: List self-issued substitute receipts (Eigenbeleg) — used when the original receipt for a transaction was lost or never issued. Each row carries the linked transactionId, recipientName, amount, reason, and signing state. Pass `transactionHash` (from `get_transactions`) to scope to one transaction. Default page 20, max 100.

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination.

transactionHash.description: Restrict to Eigenbelege linked to a single transaction (on-chain hash from get_transactions).

name: list_eigenbelege
